client.business_model: Omnichannel retailer and distributor of Christian books, Bibles, homeschool curricula and related faith-based products sold through its e-commerce site, annual catalogs, and wholesale channels.
client.client_history: Founded in 1978 by brothers Stephen and Ray Hendrickson in Lynn, Massachusetts, Christianbook has grown into one of the world’s largest distributors of Christian products. The privately-held, family-founded company rebranded from Christian Book Distributors to Christianbook in 2019 and now operates from a 370,000-sq-ft headquarters and distribution center in Peabody, MA, serving more than two million customers annually.

revenue.notes: ECDB estimates 2024 sales at $178M, whereas Grips Intelligence estimates $374M for the same year. No audited figures available; chose lower bound and flagged low confidence due to wide discrepancy.

locations.source: Christianbook.com ‘Customer Pick Up’ and company FAQ pages; Agreement document lists single Peabody, MA address
locations.notes: All sources reference only the 140 Summit Street, Peabody MA headquarters/distribution facility.

employees.notes: Employee counts reported range from 450 (Buzzfile) to 600+ (Mapquest); TopWorkplaces lists 560 and is used as midpoint.
